notes.title: Rally Mechanic Simulator Demo's up now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8500281/ce18629b72b4d505df3d4e101a6aded8044d59bd.gif[/img]
Our friends at Play2Chill have been working on [b]Rally Mechanic Simulator[/b] for a while now. And the game’s almost around the corner. They’re going to have a demo released during the upcoming Steam Next Fest. 

[previewyoutube=MUGqX_Ntmp4;full][/previewyoutube]

The demo will feature:
[list]
[*] A [b]workshop [/b]in which you’ll be able to fix and adapt your car for upcoming rallies.
[*] [b]2 rallies[/b] (a tarmac and a gravel one) which differ quite a lot in terms of preparation and management.
[*] A single [b]car inspired by Japanese rally legends[/b] from the 90s.
[*] A [b]service park[/b] - the place in which you’ll be able to fix and clean your car during the rally.
[/list]

If you’re up for some sweet sim gameplay and want to experience how it feels to be a part of a rally team, now is the time - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1588090/Rally_Mechanic_Simulator/]click this link and download the demo[/url]. It’s a blast and you should give it a shot!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1588090/Rally_Mechanic_Simulator/
